questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Correct statement(s) about the compounds $\textbf{X}$, $\textbf{Y}$ and $\textbf{Z}$ is(are)
options: $\textbf{X}$ is used for sterilizing drinking water.
$\textbf{Z}$ is used in the enrichment of $^{235}\text{U}$.
$\textbf{Y}$ is a stronger Lewis base than ammonia.
questions.solution:
From the given reactions, we can identify the compounds $\textbf{X}$, $\textbf{Y}$, and $\textbf{Z}$ as follows:

Reaction 1: $\text{MnO}_2 + 4\text{HCl (conc.)} \rightarrow \text{MnCl}_2 + \text{Cl}_2 + 2\text{H}_2\text{O}$
The greenish-yellow gas $\textbf{X}$ is $\text{Cl}_2$.

Reaction 2: $\text{NH}_3 + 3\text{Cl}_2 \text{ (excess)} \rightarrow \text{NCl}_3 + 3\text{HCl}$
Compound $\textbf{Y}$ is $\text{NCl}_3$.

Reaction 3: $\text{Cl}_2 + 3\text{F}_2 \text{ (excess)} \xrightarrow{573\text{ K}} 2\text{ClF}_3$
Compound $\textbf{Z}$ is $\text{ClF}_3$.

Evaluating the given statements:
(A) $\text{Cl}_2$ is widely used as a disinfectant for sterilizing drinking water. This statement is correct.

(B) In $\text{NCl}_3$, the nitrogen atom is $sp^3$ hybridized and possesses one lone pair of electrons. This gives it a trigonal pyramidal structure, not a planar one. This statement is incorrect.

(C) $\text{ClF}_3$ is used in the enrichment of $^{235}\text{U}$ because it reacts with uranium to produce the volatile compound $\text{UF}_6$ ($\text{U} + 3\text{ClF}_3 \rightarrow \text{UF}_6 + 3\text{ClF}$). This statement is correct.

(D) $\text{NCl}_3$ is a weaker Lewis base than $\text{NH}_3$. The highly electronegative chlorine atoms withdraw electron density from the nitrogen atom via the -I effect, making the lone pair less available for donation compared to ammonia. This statement is incorrect.

Answer: $\textbf{X}$ is used for sterilizing drinking water.; $\textbf{Z}$ is used in the enrichment of $^{235}\text{U}$.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Correct statement(s) about the compounds $\textbf{P}$, $\textbf{Q}$ and $\textbf{R}$ is(are)
options: $\textbf{P}$ has two lone pairs of electrons on the central atom.
$\textbf{Q}$ can act as a fluorinating agent.
The molecular structure of $\textbf{R}$ is trigonal pyramidal.
questions.solution:
From the given reaction conditions:

$\text{Xe(g)} + 2\text{F}_2\text{(g)} \xrightarrow[\text{1 : 5 ratio}]{\text{873 K, 7 bar}} \text{XeF}_4$
Thus, $\textbf{P}$ is $\text{XeF}_4$.

$\text{XeF}_4 + \text{O}_2\text{F}_2 \xrightarrow{\text{143 K}} \text{XeF}_6 + \text{O}_2$
Thus, $\textbf{Q}$ is $\text{XeF}_6$.

$\text{XeF}_6 + 3\text{H}_2\text{O} \xrightarrow{\text{complete hydrolysis}} \text{XeO}_3 + 6\text{HF}$
Thus, $\textbf{R}$ is $\text{XeO}_3$.

Evaluating the given options:
(A) $\textbf{P}$ ($\text{XeF}_4$) has $8$ valence electrons on the central Xe atom. It forms $4$ single bonds with F, leaving $4$ electrons which form $2$ lone pairs. This statement is correct.

(B) $\textbf{Q}$ ($\text{XeF}_6$) has $6$ bond pairs and $1$ lone pair on the central Xe atom. Its geometry is distorted octahedral, not perfect octahedral. This statement is incorrect.

(C) $\textbf{Q}$ ($\text{XeF}_6$) is a strong fluorinating agent. This statement is correct.

(D) $\textbf{R}$ ($\text{XeO}_3$) has $3$ double bonds and $1$ lone pair on the central Xe atom. Its molecular structure is trigonal pyramidal. This statement is correct.

Answer: $\textbf{P}$ has two lone pairs of electrons on the central atom.; $\textbf{Q}$ can act as a fluorinating agent.; The molecular structure of $\textbf{R}$ is trigonal pyramidal.

between nitrates and phosphates, phosphates are less abundant in earth's crust
